args.sql:
SELECT p.guid, p.sandbox, p.region, p.account_id, p.status, p.catalog_item, p.created_at, u.email
FROM provisions p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.guid = 'n7rkd'
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.babylon_guid, p.sandbox_name, p.account_id, p.provisioned_at, p.retired_at, u.email FROM provisions p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.babylon_guid = 'n7rkd' ORDER BY p.provisioned_at DESC LIMIT 5

required_missed.asked_by: Which AWS sandbox account hosts this lab
required_missed.rationale: the account id comes only from the sandbox DB; the log names the sandbox, not the id
the region is set only in the provisioning log; the describe_instances default is us-east-1

required_missed.asked_by: what is each one's instance id, type and state
required_missed.rationale: the bastion's instance id, returned only by describe_instances in the lab's region

counts_missed.asked_by: How many EC2 instances does the lab have
counts_missed.rationale: describe_instances in ap-southeast-2 returns 3; the default region returns 0
